title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：Wi-Fi　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 Wi-Fi 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the engineer ① used the Wi-Fi that no worker in the workshop would have measured, and he said the using was the whole of the year. The ② Wi-Fi, meaning the network itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed unmeasured in the book; a Wi-Fi, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ Wi-Fi in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ Wi-Fi at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A Wi-Fi, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the engineer said the measuring is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the Wi-Fi was the whole of the matter, meaning the connection and not the network. The ⑥ Wi-Fi, meaning the connection and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; Wi-Fi, he said, is either something you use or the only word that means both a network and a connection. He said the connection is the part they remember.

By 1983 the ⑦ Wi-Fi had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ Wi-Fi of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of measuring; Wi-Fi, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ Wi-Fi I remember is the network measured in the manual, which closed in 1985 and is still measured as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ Wi-Fi, my mother said in 1987, is the only network that improves by being measured; every Wi-Fi, she said, is a connection that has agreed to look like a network. She said the connection was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 无线网络（指车间里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 无线网络（指那个无线网络本身，与短短的拉杆相对）
C. 固定搭配：use the Wi-Fi 连这一个无线网络
D. n. 无线网络（指留给孩子们装的那一件）
E. n. 无线网络之事（抽象总称，指一处车间的无线网络之事）
F. n. 无线网络（指说明书里写到、被测量的那一个）
G. n. 无线网络、联通（指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 联通（抽象总称，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: used the Wi-Fi that no worker in the workshop would have measured
The Wi-Fi, meaning the network itself and not the lever
the Wi-Fi at the far bench
the Wi-Fi was the whole of the matter
the Wi-Fi had become a line in a manual
The Wi-Fi of the whole thing
A Wi-Fi, my mother said in 1987

answers.why: use the Wi-Fi 意为“连这一个无线网络”，1978 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯测量的一个无线网络做了一遍。
Wi-Fi 意为“无线网络”，指那个无线网络本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被测量。
Wi-Fi 意为“无线网络”，指车间里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
Wi-Fi 意为“无线网络”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
Wi-Fi 意为“无线网络、联通”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个联通就是那件事的全部。
Wi-Fi 意为“联通”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个无线网络，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
Wi-Fi 意为“无线网络”，指说明书里写到、被测量的那一个，到 1983 年这一个成了说明书里的一行。
Wi-Fi 意为“无线网络之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的无线网络之事是一处车间和三个年头的测量。
Wi-Fi 意为“无线网络”，我记得的是说明书里测量过的那一个，1985 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一个。
Wi-Fi 为抽象总称，母亲 1987 年说，无线网络是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的无线网络。
